article.content: Former BBC presenter says programme starring Martin Clunes gave a misleading and unfair account of his downfall Britain’s media regulator is investigating a complaint from the former BBC news presenter Huw Edwards about a Channel 5 drama depicting his downfall. Ofcom said it was investigating Power: The Downfall of Huw Edwards , which starred Martin Clunes and was broadcast earlier this year, under its “fairness and privacy” rules. Continue reading...
